ticket.summary: New customer at 61 Foxtail Dr. wants proactive replacement of a working 14-year-old 40-gal gas water heater in the garage; quoted WH-REPLACE-40G $1,450 + permit at cost, needs a half-day block — no after-hours slot fit, office to call in the morning.
mitigation_advice: No mitigation needed - unit is working with no leaks; advised that if water ever pools under the tank, turn the gas control dial to OFF and close the cold-water inlet valve on top of the tank, and do not drain it themselves [PB-04]

quote_lines.description: 40-gal gas water heater replacement (same location, existing gas/vent/water connections, includes haul-away)

ticket.customer_message: Perfect - got it: 61 Foxtail Dr., water heater in the garage. I've filed a ticket for a proactive 40-gal gas water heater replacement (WH-REPLACE-40G, $1,450 flat + permit at cost, ~4.5 hrs on site), and the office will call you tomorrow morning to book a half-day block. Since your unit is still working fine, there's nothing you need to do tonight - but if you ever spot water pooling under the tank, turn the gas control dial to OFF and close the cold-water inlet valve on top of the tank, then call us [PB-04]. Thanks for choosing Brookdale!
